name: __ASSISTANT_NAME__ - __AGENT_NAME__ real estate
firstMessage: Hi, thanks for calling __AGENT_NAME__'s office at __BROKERAGE__, this is __ASSISTANT_NAME__, __AGENT_NAME__'s AI assistant. How can I help you today?
voicemailMessage: Hi, this is __ASSISTANT_NAME__, the AI assistant for __AGENT_NAME__ at __BROKERAGE__ about your home enquiry. Call or text us back at __AGENT_PHONE__ whenever suits. Thanks!
endCallMessage: Thanks so much, have a great day!

function.name: search_listings
function.description: Search the agent's current listings for homes matching what the caller wants. Use once you know at least an area or a budget.

area.description: City, neighbourhood or zip code. Several can be separated by commas.

max_price.description: Top of budget in dollars, e.g. 500000.

min_price.description: Bottom of budget in dollars, if they gave one.

messages.content: Let me pull up what we have.

function.name: check_availability
function.description: Get open showing times on one day from the agent's calendar.

date.description: The day to check, as YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: book_showing
function.description: Book a property showing on the agent's calendar. Only use a start_time returned by check_availability.

property_address.description: Street address of the home to show.

property_id.description: property_id from search_listings, if the home came from there.

phone.description: Caller's phone, only if different from the number they are calling from.

notes.description: Anything the agent should know before the showing.

function.name: transfer_to_agent
function.description: Transfer the call to __AGENT_NAME__ when the caller asks for a person, is upset, or needs something you cannot help with.

destinations.message: Sure, I'll connect you with __AGENT_NAME__ now. One moment.

timeline.description: When they want to move, in their words, e.g. 'within 3 months'.

budget_max.description: Top of buying budget in dollars, or estimated home value for sellers.

showing_time.description: Booked showing time as said on the call.

property_interest.description: Address of the property they asked about or booked.

lead_score.description: 1-10. 9-10: ready to act within 30 days with budget or pre-approval, or a seller. 6-8: moving within 3 months. 3-5: 3-12 months or browsing. 1-2: not a real lead, has an agent, or wrong number.

next_step.description: The single next action for the agent.

do_not_call.description: Caller asked not to be called again.
